name: unique
expr: us = unique(x); ust = unique(x, 'stable'); [u, ia, ic] = unique([3 1 4 1 5], 'stable');
comment: Sig: u = unique(x); u = unique(x,'stable'); [u,ia,ic] = unique(x,setOrder). Covers: default 'sorted' (ascending), 'stable' (first-occurrence order, no sort), and three-output 'stable' index vectors (ia into x, ic into u). Spec-extension batch 2026-05-09; 'stable' added queue-clearing 2026-05-29.
